english: Why can a metal part fail even when no single load is large enough to break it?
chinese: 為什麼金屬零件會斷裂，即使每一次載重都不足以單獨把它弄斷？
caption:
Why can a metal part fail even when no single load is large enough
to break it?

english: Fatigue is damage from repeated loading. It can occur when nominal stress stays below yield strength.
chinese: 疲勞是反覆載重造成的損傷。即使名義應力低於材料的降伏強度，也可能發生破壞。
caption:
Fatigue is damage from repeated loading. It can occur when nominal
stress stays below yield strength.

english: This is a real fractured bolt from published research.
chinese: 這是一張已發表研究中的真實斷裂螺栓照片。
caption: This is a real fractured bolt from published research.

english: The paper notes that fatigue commonly occurs at thread roots.
chinese: 論文指出，螺栓的疲勞破壞常發生在螺紋根部。
caption: The paper notes that fatigue commonly occurs at thread roots.

english: The exact origin is not mapped here.
chinese: 這張照片並未標示確切的裂紋起始位置。
caption: The exact origin is not mapped here.

english: Fatigue surfaces may show smoother growth regions and rougher final fracture; appearances vary.
chinese: 疲勞斷面可能有較平滑的成長區和較粗糙的最終斷裂區；實際外觀並不完全相同。
caption:
Fatigue surfaces may show smoother growth regions and rougher final
fracture; appearances vary.

english: Now follow one schematic specimen.
chinese: 現在我們用同一個示意試件，觀察整個過程。
caption: Now follow one schematic specimen.

english: A scratch concentrates stress locally, and a small crack begins.
chinese: 刮痕造成局部應力集中，微小裂紋因而起始。
caption: A scratch concentrates stress locally, and a small crack begins.

english: Repeated tension opens the crack.
chinese: 反覆拉伸使裂紋張開。
caption: Repeated tension opens the crack.

english: As cycle count N increases, crack length a grows, leaving less intact material.
chinese: 隨著循環次數 N 增加，裂紋長度 a 增長，剩餘完整的材料逐漸減少。
caption:
As cycle count N increases, crack length a grows, leaving less
intact material.

english: The gradual growth may be hard to see. The sudden break is only the final stage.
chinese: 逐漸發展的裂紋可能很難察覺。突然斷裂只是整個過程的最後階段。
caption:
The gradual growth may be hard to see. The sudden break is only the
final stage.

english: Once the crack reaches a critical condition, the remaining section fractures rapidly.
chinese: 當裂紋達到臨界狀態，剩餘截面便快速斷裂。
caption:
Once the crack reaches a critical condition, the remaining section
fractures rapidly.

english: An S–N curve connects stress amplitude to fatigue life.
chinese: S–N 曲線把應力振幅與疲勞壽命連結起來。
caption: An S–N curve connects stress amplitude to fatigue life.

english: S is half the difference between maximum and minimum stress.
chinese: S 是最大應力與最小應力之差的一半。
caption: S is half the difference between maximum and minimum stress.

english: The vertical axis is stress amplitude in megapascals.
chinese: 縱軸是應力振幅，單位為百萬帕斯卡，也就是 MPa。
caption: The vertical axis is stress amplitude in megapascals.

english: The horizontal axis shows cycles to failure on a logarithmic scale.
chinese: 橫軸用對數刻度表示試件破壞前所承受的循環次數。
caption: The horizontal axis shows cycles to failure on a logarithmic scale.

english: Choose a stress, move across to the curve, then down to read life.
chinese: 選定應力振幅，水平移到曲線，再垂直向下讀出疲勞壽命。
caption: Choose a stress, move across to the curve, then down to read life.

english: For the same material and conditions, lower amplitude usually means longer life.
chinese: 對相同材料和試驗條件而言，較低的應力振幅通常代表較長的壽命。
caption:
For the same material and conditions, lower amplitude usually means
longer life.

english: Actual results scatter.
chinese: 實際試驗結果具有分散性。
caption: Actual results scatter.

english: Some steels show a fatigue limit under specific test conditions.
chinese: 某些鋼材在特定試驗條件下會呈現疲勞限。
caption: Some steels show a fatigue limit under specific test conditions.

english: Aluminum alloys generally do not. These limits are not universal safety guarantees.
chinese: 鋁合金通常沒有明確的疲勞限。這些試驗中的極限，也不是適用於所有情況的安全保證。
caption:
Aluminum alloys generally do not. These limits are not universal
safety guarantees.

english: Fracture toughness measures resistance to fracture with a crack.
chinese: 斷裂韌性衡量材料已經存在裂紋時，抵抗斷裂的能力。
caption: Fracture toughness measures resistance to fracture with a crack.

english: K I describes crack tip loading: the Mode one stress intensity factor.
chinese: K I 描述裂紋尖端的載重狀態，是第一型，也就是張開型的應力強度因子。
caption:
K I describes crack tip loading: the Mode one stress intensity
factor.

english: Y describes geometry; sigma is tensile stress; a measures edge to tip.
chinese: Y 反映幾何形狀；sigma 是施加的拉伸應力；a 是從試件邊緣到裂紋尖端的長度。
caption:
Y describes geometry; sigma is tensile stress; a measures edge to
tip.

english: Raising stress or lengthening the crack increases K I.
chinese: 提高應力，或使裂紋增長，都會增加 K I。
caption: Raising stress or lengthening the crack increases K I.

english: K I c is material plane strain fracture toughness, not yield strength.
chinese: K I c 是材料的平面應變斷裂韌性，並不是降伏強度。
caption:
K I c is material plane strain fracture toughness, not yield
strength.

english: Under linear elastic, valid plane strain conditions, peak K I reaching K I c can trigger rapid fracture.
chinese: 在線彈性且符合有效平面應變條件下，最大 K I 達到 K I c 時，可能觸發快速斷裂。
caption:
Under linear elastic, valid plane strain conditions, peak K I
reaching K I c can trigger rapid fracture.

english: Fatigue cracks can grow below this limit.
chinese: 疲勞裂紋在低於這個臨界值時，也能逐漸成長。
caption: Fatigue cracks can grow below this limit.

english: Repeated loading can cause fatigue damage.
chinese: 反覆載重可能造成疲勞損傷。
caption: Repeated loading can cause fatigue damage.

english: S–N curves relate stress amplitude to fatigue life.
chinese: S–N 曲線描述應力振幅與疲勞壽命的關係。
caption: S–N curves relate stress amplitude to fatigue life.

english: Fracture toughness helps assess when an existing crack becomes critical.
chinese: 斷裂韌性有助於評估既有裂紋何時達到臨界狀態。
caption:
Fracture toughness helps assess when an existing crack becomes
critical.

english: Reduce stress concentrations, improve surface condition, and inspect for cracks to reduce fatigue risk.
chinese: 降低應力集中、改善表面狀況，並檢查裂紋，可以降低疲勞破壞的風險。
caption:
Reduce stress concentrations, improve surface condition, and inspect
for cracks to reduce fatigue risk.

english: These sources support the lesson. Full links, photo credits, and reproducible code accompany this video.
chinese: 本影片以這些來源為依據，並附上完整連結、照片出處和可重現的程式碼。
caption:
These sources support the lesson. Full links, photo credits, and
reproducible code accompany this video.
